Movie 📽️🎥👇
Storks (2016)

Genre: Animation, Adventure, Comedy, Family, Fantasy

IMDb Rating: 6.8/10

Runtime: 1h 27m

Directors: Nicholas Stoller & Doug Sweetland

Main Cast: Andy Samberg, Katie Crown, Kelsey Grammer, Jennifer Aniston, Ty Burrell, Keegan-Michael Key

Rare Fact: In Storks, Junior is a delivery stork who is desperate to become the top performer at Cornerstore.com. But when an accidentally activated Baby Making Machine creates an adorable baby, Junior and Tulip have to deliver her before anyone finds out. The movie plays with the classic myth that storks deliver babies while turning it into a hilarious modern workplace comedy.

About the Movie:

Storks follows Junior, the company's best delivery stork, who is about to receive a major promotion. However, his plans completely fall apart when Tulip, the only human living at the mountain-top delivery company, accidentally activates the long-forgotten Baby Making Machine. The machine produces an adorable baby girl, and Junior suddenly finds himself responsible for delivering a baby to her family-even though baby deliveries are supposed to be a thing of the past.

What follows is a chaotic and heartwarming adventure as Junior and Tulip travel across the world to find the baby's family while trying to keep their mission a secret. Beneath all the jokes, crazy action and adorable characters, Storks carries a surprisingly sweet message about family, responsibility and the importance of being there for the people you love. The movie turns an old childhood legend into a fast-paced animated adventure filled with comedy, unlikely friendship and plenty of emotional moments
